title: Reading Drill — Choosing shades for playgrounds — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing shades for playgrounds — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The school grounds team in Millcross received an old report about shade falling outside the places where pupils queue. The report compared the shaded share of the line, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the shadow tracings rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include changes in queue length. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a rotated shade canopy as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
